First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social.
Check
Look at @tacomatnr the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tacoma Tuesday Night Ride group ride

A social Tuesday night ride around Tacoma. It leaves from a different bar each week, so check Instagram or Facebook for the start. Usually ends with a hangout after.
